review_kind: Codex AI technical translation and review; no native-speaker signoff
note: Source-bound YOLO box controls and notices. Drawing/moving/resizing/deleting, overlapping boxes, standalone sources, recrop ordering, blinding and export failures reviewed explicitly; keyboard keys, file patterns and placeholders preserved.

records.key: Box annotations need a standalone image. Export the image from this segmentation bundle first, then open it in Make Masks.
records.source: Box annotations need a standalone image. Export the image from this segmentation bundle first, then open it in Make Masks.
records.translation: 상자 주석에는 독립된 이미지가 필요합니다. 먼저 이 분할 번들에서 이미지를 내보낸 다음 Make Masks에서 여세요.

records.key: Class for a selected box or the next box
records.source: Class for a selected box or the next box
records.translation: 선택한 상자 또는 다음 상자의 클래스

records.key: Delete the box under the cursor
records.source: Delete the box under the cursor

records.key: Draw YOLO bounding boxes (X). Drag inside to move, drag a corner to resize, or right-click to delete. Ctrl-drag draws an overlapping box.
records.source: Draw YOLO bounding boxes (X). Drag inside to move, drag a corner to resize, or right-click to delete. Ctrl-drag draws an overlapping box.
records.translation: YOLO 경계 상자 그리기 (X). 내부를 드래그하여 이동하거나 모서리를 드래그하여 크기를 조절하고, 마우스 오른쪽 버튼을 클릭하여 삭제하세요. Ctrl을 누른 채 드래그하면 겹치는 상자를 그립니다.

records.key: Enter a unique, nonempty class name.
records.source: Enter a unique, nonempty class name.
records.translation: 고유하고 비어 있지 않은 클래스 이름을 입력하세요.

records.key: Export this image's boxes as a YOLO .txt label file with a class-name companion.
records.source: Export this image's boxes as a YOLO .txt label file with a class-name companion.
records.translation: 이 이미지의 상자를 클래스 이름 보조 파일과 함께 YOLO .txt 라벨 파일로 내보냅니다.

records.key: Move to a cropped field before adding box annotations.
records.source: Move to a cropped field before adding box annotations.
records.translation: 상자 주석을 추가하기 전에 잘라낸 시야로 이동하세요.

records.key: Remove this image's box annotations before recropping it.
records.source: Remove this image's box annotations before recropping it.
records.translation: 이 이미지를 다시 자르기 전에 상자 주석을 제거하세요.

records.key: Unblind this session before exporting labels named after source images.
records.source: Unblind this session before exporting labels named after source images.
records.translation: 원본 이미지 이름을 사용하는 라벨을 내보내기 전에 이 세션의 눈가림을 해제하세요.

records.key: YOLO export is off while blinded
records.source: YOLO export is off while blinded
